ideas.reasoning: This tests whether the changed exploration lane improves the selected incumbent, rather than merely producing better exploration candidates. One run per configuration cannot separate pipeline effects from search randomness; another exploration-only efficacy comparison would not resolve competition with the unchanged fittable lane, so start with no-spend integration tests instead.
suggested_changes: Hypothesis: Single-phase generation plus rollout search supplies stronger exploration candidates that survive selection against the unchanged fittable lane and improve the run's selected incumbent.

Run six independent searches per configuration, arranged as six paired blocks; this provides an initial run-level uncertainty estimate, not guaranteed power for a +0.05 effect. Control run seeds: 3100, 3102, 3104, 3106, 3108, 3110; treatment run seeds: 3101, 3103, 3105, 3107, 3109, 3111. Use independent generation calls, identical manifests within each block, and unchanged candidate-slot allocations and fittable-lane settings. Do not substitute placement count for independent search replication.

Reuse scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/two_lane_search.yaml; derive config/two_lane_search_v2.yaml with only the exploration generation/search changes. Retain the existing disjoint probe/screen assignment, 24-candidate independent rollout search and checkpoint tie rule, bc_steps=0, and existing promotion rule. Do not introduce adaptive search, parameterization-contract prompting, edit generations, or additional fittable parents.

Allow a minimal code-derived idea record only when explicitly identified as code-derived: parameter declarations come from get_param_ranges, and zero-shot behaviour is marked not asserted rather than invented. Preserve a schema-valid seedless root, generation-call provenance, code hash, and links from every searched parameter state to its root and search trace. If the schema cannot represent unknown behaviour, add that explicit representation without weakening ExperimentRecord lineage validation; test serialization and lineage before live spending.

Freeze both configurations and each run's selected incumbent before opening fresh confirmation outcomes. Reuse scripts/evaluate_on_fresh_manifest.py with pool seeds 3130, 3131, 3132, 3133, 3134, 3135: one distinct 50-placement confirmation manifest per paired block, shared between its two incumbents. Confirmation is evaluation-only and cannot select candidates or substitute for promotion on development cases 10–39. Never read the final-test split.

Prediction: metric=paired_success_difference, direction=increase, threshold=0.05, against=fresh reruns of config/two_lane_search.yaml, comparing each configuration's selected incumbent. Average the six block-level paired success differences and report a paired t 95% interval with five degrees of freedom, using scripts/compare_evolution_runs.py where supported. Report exploration-lane outcomes separately, not as evidence for the incumbent prediction.

falsified_by: An upper run-level paired 95% bound below +0.05 refutes the predicted magnitude. An interval including zero is inconclusive about improvement, and tied success is never improvement. Establish the predicted magnitude only if the lower bound reaches +0.05; otherwise distinguish evidence for a smaller positive effect from an unresolved magnitude. The measurement needed to resolve remaining search uncertainty is additional independently generated paired-run success differences, not more resampling of the same runs.

Budget: cap the twelve complete searches at 18000 simulator episodes and 270 LLM calls combined, plus exactly 600 confirmation episodes and zero confirmation LLM calls: total ceiling 18600 episodes and 270 calls. This is a planning ceiling, not a measured cost; enumerate the actual configurations offline before launch, including corrections and all probe/screen/promotion evaluations. If complete runs exceed either ceiling, return for a revised budget rather than truncating searches. All calls use gpt-6.1-sol, reasoning_effort high, temperature 1; execute through gpu run and keep the GPU up for this session.

next_step: Have Claude Code produce the no-spend configuration and lineage audit, including exact episode and LLM-call enumeration for the six-pair protocol, before launching live runs.
